description: Reference points for the Data-Density Reserve depletion curve D(G) = min(cap_tokens, c * ln(1 + G / K_usd)), checked against protocol/applications/economics/parameters.json. Values are floored to six-decimal base units (never rounded up past the enforced cap), matching the paper's stated integer fixed-point execution model. This vector is data-only in scripts/verify_conformance.mjs (no executable verifier is wired into that shared harness); it is evaluated by the standalone scripts/check_data_density_reserve_curve.mjs.

cases.note: Exact integer fixed-point result at the paper's reference ceiling point; slightly below the 70,000,000,000,000 base-unit cap by design.
